excluded_repos.matplotlib/matplotlib: images cannot be unpacked on the rootless daemon (subuid range)

procedure:
Deterministic task sample for the public natural corpus (PNC).

Population: SWE-bench Verified (500), minus matplotlib/matplotlib (images cannot be unpacked on our rootless daemon)
and pylint-dev/pylint (GPL-2.0; PI decision 2026-11-04, see DEVIATIONS.md) -> 456 tasks.
S1: 400 tasks, stratified by repository (proportional allocation, largest remainder), rng = random.Random(20261104):
    repos in sorted order; within a repo, sorted instance ids are shuffled and the first quota taken.
S2: simple random sample of 100 of the 400 S1 tasks (same rng, continued).
Run order: the 400 tasks shuffled (same rng, continued); each S2 episode runs right after its task's S1 episode.
Writes configs/tasks_S1.txt, configs/tasks_S2.txt, configs/run_order.json and data/pnc/tasks.json.

extension.decision: PI design addition, 2026-11-04 15:3x UTC, decided blind (paper/protocol_theory/prereg/PREREG_DEVIATIONS.md, PI entries); runs after the 500 planned Verified jobs until the 07:45 cutoff
extension.procedure:
Corpus extension (PI design addition 2026-11-04 15:3x UTC, decided blind; see DEVIATIONS.md).

Population: SWE-bench full test split (princeton-nlp/SWE-bench, revision recorded in tasks.json), non-Verified instances
of the same permissively licensed repositories (matplotlib and pylint excluded), whose official instance image
docker.io/swebench/sweb.eval.x86_64.<repo>_1776_<id> exists (checked by manifest HEAD: scripts/check_ext_images.py).
Order: random and stratified by repository, seed 20261104: within each repository the sorted ids are shuffled with
random.Random(20261104) (repositories in sorted order, one rng); the k-th task of repository r (n_r tasks) gets the
position (k + u_r) / n_r with u_r ~ U[0,1) drawn from the same rng, and all tasks are sorted by position (ties by a
further uniform draw). Every prefix of the order is therefore close to proportional by repository.
One S1 episode per task, split "swebench_test_ext", appended after the 500 planned Verified jobs (split "verified").
Writes configs/ext_order.json, configs/ext_images.json, configs/run_order_v2.json and updates data/pnc/tasks.json.
